page.overview:
Who is Queen Eliza?

Queen Eliza is one of the five Outworlders who are the founders of the lost city of Sinkiang in Outworld. She is mentioned but never seen in Mortal Kombat: Special Forces.

But that time of peace would not last. The vicious Shao Kahn's rise to power has plunged Outworld into a state of opression and chaos. The founders devised an important plan to escape Kahn's tyrannical reign by retreating to an unknown realm with the aid of a secret portal they created.

When the three arrived, they were in a mountainous region within an unfamiliar realm. That realm is Earthrealm. Eliza and her two friends then begin their settlement here with the help of human Earthrealmers they stumbled across and asked for help. Together they built a city named Sin Kiang. The trio of Outworld queens who became the only ruling council of the city, were often worshipped by these Earthrealm natives as goddesses because of their unusual lifespan and their awesome magic. Many years later, the three Outworlders who wanted a better life, simply died of old age, and the city of Sin Kiang began to be deserted. It would remain forgotten for centuries to come.

Centuries later, Major Jax Briggs while hunting the dangerous Black Dragon criminal Kano, entered the lost city of Sinkiang in the Xinjiang province of China.
